annotations.title: Add an agenda, speakers or sponsors from pasted text (organizers only)

description: Reads text the organizer pasted or dictated about an event they run (an agenda, a speaker or sponsor list, a flyer) and proposes the sessions, speakers, sponsors, dates and venue it found. FIRST CALL WITHOUT `confirm` returns a PROPOSAL with an `intakeId` and changes nothing; read it back, and only when the organizer says yes call again with `confirm: true` and that `intakeId`. Files are uploaded on the organizer dashboard instead. Only the organizer of the event can add to it. It requires a personal connector token.

confirm.description: Leave out for the proposal; after a yes, true with the intakeId.

customColor.description: Optional #rrggbb; a hard to read color is refused with the closest readable shade. For the new draft only; an existing event's colors change through event_change_detail.

eventIdOrName.description: REQUIRED. The event name as the organizer says it, or its web address.

intakeId.description: REQUIRED with confirm: the intakeId the proposal returned.

kind.description: OPTIONAL. What the text is, when the organizer said so.

paletteId.description: With templateId: one of its palette ids. For the new draft only; an existing event's colors change through event_change_detail.

templateId.description: Optional; a template id from the dashboard (birthday_party, quince_classic, baby_shower_soft, wedding_gallery).

text.description: The pasted or dictated text. Required on the first call.
